title: Rain
blurb: Steady rainfall, no thunder in it, and the plain unglamorous version happens to be the one people actually want. Rain is comfortably the most-searched ambient sound on the internet, because it does two entirely unrelated jobs extremely well. It masks other noise for anyone trying to sleep or concentrate, and it fills the silence under a shot that would otherwise feel dead. Twelve seconds loops cleanly enough for either. Free MP3 for study playlists, video edits, or a windowless room that needs weather.
